picks.what: The Buer district seen from a height, photograph
picks.why: view over central Buer (part of Gelsenkirchen since 1928) with its main church; trams and cars fit the date

gaps: P0–P4: nothing; P6: no usable view of the center or skyline
notes: All historical candidates (#1–#4) show Buer, the northern district merged into Gelsenkirchen in 1928, not the old center; the date comes only from the file names and there is no author or source. #3 chosen for the church landmark; drop it if Buer is too far from the map point. #3 is only 914 px wide. P6: #5 is a 7:1 panorama of Buer’s green outskirts with railings in the foreground; #6 is the Scholven refinery, #7 the canal, #8 the prison.
